title: Create a Patient training table
objective: Let a researcher choose one row per Patient, add Gender, and see exact row-key and coverage evidence through the existing end-to-end path
unit_gate: go test ./internal/explorer/... ./internal/server; cd ui && npm test -- DatasetWizard FeatureEditor; node --test scripts/loom-dev.test.mjs
live_gate: make dev-doctor && make verify-fast; assert Patient grain, Gender values, complete bounded evidence, and one authoring receipt
iteration_gate: After each typed-boundary or UI slice, run the focused Go or UI behavior test and refresh the warm browser path
integration_gate: Run Go, OpenAPI, UI, driver tests, and make verify-fast at package head; run verify-full because the fixture and driver change
performance_gate: Record warm reconcile, evidence, preview, and HMR/Air timings; investigate a repeated regression above 10 percent
migration_gate: New wizard Explorers use design v1; existing drafts stay on the current Builder path and are never inferred
rollback: Disable the per-Explorer wizard flag and revert F1 commits; keep the original Builder, Viewer, and fixture path
user_demo: Create one row per Patient, add Gender, and see female/null plus 2 rows, 0 null keys, and 0 duplicate keys

title: Turn related records into features
objective: Let a researcher create count, yes-or-no, and related-value features without recipes and without silent one-to-many loss
unit_gate: go test ./internal/explorer/... ./internal/dataframe/compiler/... ./internal/server; cd ui && npm test -- DatasetWizard FeatureEditor
live_gate: make dev-doctor && make verify-fast; assert counts 2/1, final counts 1/1, exists true/false, and explicit multiplicity policy
iteration_gate: Run one literal feature-value test after each source-union, compiler, or feature-card change on the warm stack
integration_gate: Run compiler, Go, OpenAPI, UI, and make verify-fast gates at package head
performance_gate: Measure warm feature save, reconcile, evidence, and preview latency; investigate a repeated regression above 10 percent
migration_gate: Version the feature-source union; legacy related FIRST remains readable only in the legacy flow until the user supplies intent
rollback: Revert F2 as one sequence; do not leave controls that advertise a source variant the compiler cannot persist
user_demo: Add Observation count, final count, and preliminary yes-or-no, then resolve a related value with an explicit policy

title: Check and repair the dataset
objective: Turn receipt-bound measurements into actionable readiness reasons that focus the responsible row or feature control
unit_gate: go test ./internal/explorer/... ./internal/dataframe/compiler/... ./internal/fhir/schema/... ./internal/server; cd ui && npm test -- DatasetWizard FeatureEditor DataframeContractPanel ExplorerViewer
live_gate: make dev-doctor && make verify-fast; assert measured reason codes, direct repair focus, and publication blocking only for hard failures
iteration_gate: After each metric or reason, run its focused behavior test and the corresponding DOM repair assertion on the warm stack
integration_gate: Run Go, OpenAPI, UI, and make verify-fast gates at package head
performance_gate: Measure bounded receipt profiling and feature-card interaction latency; report limits or incomplete evidence instead of hiding it
migration_gate: Add a versioned evidence and feature-descriptor contract; legacy unknown role and missing meaning produce warnings, not invented values
rollback: Revert F3 contracts and UI together; preserve F1/F2 authoring and the legacy contract panel
user_demo: Open Check, inspect exact quality evidence, click a reason, repair its feature, and see readiness update under the same receipt

title: Download one reproducible training artifact
objective: Publish once and download a server-produced artifact whose data, schema, quality, provenance, and checksums share one immutable identity
unit_gate: go test ./internal/dataframe/published/... ./internal/api/graphql/graph/dataframe/... ./internal/dataset/... ./internal/server; cd ui && npm test -- DatasetWizard ExplorerViewer
live_gate: make dev-doctor && make verify-fast; unpack the artifact and assert members, values, identities, and hashes
iteration_gate: After each exporter or UI state change, run the focused stream/job test and one warm artifact request
integration_gate: Run Go, OpenAPI, GraphQL, UI, and make verify-fast gates; run verify-full only if driver or watcher mechanics change
performance_gate: Measure server and browser memory plus time for bounded small and multi-page exports; incomplete streams never become downloads
migration_gate: Artifact v1 is additive and uses CSV; keep the current Viewer CSV until every caller uses the pinned server artifact
rollback: Disable artifact creation and revert F4; published revisions and the current Viewer CSV remain readable
user_demo: Publish, download a six-member checksummed archive, and prove that concurrent republish and failure cannot mix or complete it
